gaps.what: No page gives a Western Turk holding in Sogdia or Ferghana after 657, a border, or an area for 666-698; the dossier is thin by design (5 events, soft)

No page gives the Turgesh border for 745-765 (drawn as Zhetysu alone); the Tarim holdings of 715-717 and the Tang gain of Dzungaria are inferred; Zhetysu is Uyghur in Cliopatria's 760 shape against the Karluks page (766)

Pre-880 Kimaks (743-879) have no state page; the Dnieper-Danube steppe of Cumania is not in the shape; the Cliopatria steps of 896, 1072, 1147, 1210, 1220 and 1227 are undated by any page; the Naiman displacement of the Altai edge is undated
Cliopatria's Halych-Volhynia occupation row (eu-16) holds the Pontic steppe west of 38 E that the Cumans page gives to the Cumans
The two Oghuz pages disagree on when the lower Syr Darya and Aral steppes were taken (700s versus beginning of the 9th century); Khwarezm fringe (255 cells) drawn as Oghuz from 750

problems: WebFetch returns a model-written extract of each page, not the page text: the quoted sentences in notes are the extract's wording and some may be close paraphrases; a reviewer reopening a page should expect small wording differences.

Cliopatria row 'Turks' is not a state with an article (Wikipedia title is a disambiguation page; Wikidata Q2118293 is shared with Oghuz Turks); the turks dossier keeps only the Western Turk remnant 666-698 and marks the 750-756 shapes wrong. 'Türgesh' 692-749 is mostly the Second Turkic Khaganate: that state needs a dossier and no batch owns it.

kimek-kipchak-confederation: start moved to 880 and end to 1241 (Cliopatria 750-1235); shapes 750, 793, 850 marked wrong; the Cuman steppe west of 38 E is drawn by Cliopatria's Halych-Volhynia occupation row (eu-16), which should be checked.
Page budget: turks and turgesh opened 6 pages each (budget 5) because the shared pages serve both; kimek used 8 of 9, oghuz-turks 5 of 5.

Matching events other dossiers should carry are listed in the notes file (tang-dynasty, umayyad-caliphate, qarlugs, seljuk-dynasty, great-seljuk-empire, ghaznavid-empire, kara-khitans, khwarezmid-empire, mongol-empire).
Wikipedia page Khwarazmian_dynasty returned 404; Khwarazmian_Empire was used instead.
